name: peecho-mcp
description: Peecho (Prodigi Group) (ecommerce suppliers): me, quote_shipping, create_order, get_order. Every too

platform_mcp_peecho_merchant_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PEECHO_MERCHANT_API_KEY
platform_mcp_peecho_merchant_api_key.description: Peecho Merchant API key (dashboard > Settings > API), sent as the merchantApiKey query parameter and inside order/quote bodies. Test-environment keys belong to https://test.www.peecho.com/rest/v3/, which this server does not switch to.

platform_mcp_peecho_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PEECHO_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_peecho_currency.description: Currency for create_order (required by Peecho, e.g. EUR or USD) and quote_shipping prices (EUR when unset).

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists the offerings active on the account (grouped by category and sub-category codes).

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: POST /rest/v3/quote for one offering (product_id = offeringId from Settings > Products) shipped to `country` (ISO-2): quotedItems[{productPrice, shippingWholesale, totalItemPrice, vat}] with quoteDetails and quoteSummary{totalWholesalePrice, totalShippingPrice} in `raw`. numberOfPages is not sent, so Peecho quotes the product's minimum page count; the default STANDARD shipping option is used.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Creates an OPEN (unpaid) order: nothing is produced or charged until the order is paid with POST /order/payment, which this server does not call. `items` are Peecho item_details [{offering_id, quantity, item_reference, file_details{content_url, content_width, content_height, number_of_pages}}]; `shipping_address` is Peecho's address_details {email_address, shipping_address{first_name, last_name, address_line_1, address_line_2, zip_code, city, state, country_code (ISO-2)}}; `shipping_option` is STANDARD or EXPEDITED. The currency setting is required by Peecho. Answers 201 {order_id}.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /rest/v3/order/details?orderId=: {order_id, order_state (OPEN, PAID, PAYMENT_ERROR, IN_PRINT_QUEUE, SHIPPED, ...), created_date, currency, tracking_code, tracking_url, order_price_data (decimal strings, so the wholesale total is returned as wholesale_total_inc_taxes), item_price_data, address_details, fulfilment_location}.
